scientific_integrity: Original formulas and proof acknowledge established graph definition and quotient blow-up theorem, without suggesting independent audit or global literature exhaustion.
scientific_limitations: Field-and-rank rigidity only within free class-two finite-field Lie algebras; broader weighted blow-up structure is previously known, and historical equivalence with older subalgebra enumerations remains possible. Small checks cannot certify all-field proof.
title: Degree-multiset rigidity for comaximal graphs of free class-two Lie algebras
